name: Actuation Actuator Effect Pattern
description: Ontology design pattern for modeling actuation actuator effect relationships and concepts.
competency_questions: Which physical quantity does a given device change, and what effect does it have on its surroundings?; Which commands has a device received, what value did each command carry, and when was it issued?; How quickly does a device react after a command arrives, and what range of commands can it accept without damaging itself?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
